in_sanskrit.name: Ashmit
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ash - not, mit - fear. Freedom from fear.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashmit एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Ashmit is derived from two roots: Ash, meaning ‘not’ or ‘free from’, and Mit, meaning ‘fear’. Therefore, Ashmit symbolizes freedom from fear, courage, and bravery. In Hindu mythology, Ashmit is associated with the god Shiva, who is known to overcome fear and destruction.
